facts.fact: 夏季最后一天：Sean 开卡车来接 Billie 去湖边瀑布。
facts.anchor: After getting dressed, I can hear his truck pull into the driveway to begin our day at the lake.

facts.fact: 车里 Sean 突然说出「我爱你」——Billie 嘴如缝住，说不出回答（她其实一直爱他）。
facts.anchor: “Gosh, I just love you,” he breathes out.

facts.fact: 他随即改口夸她 gorgeous，用未说破的方式替她解围。
facts.anchor: “Seriously, gorgeous,” he compliments again, his unsaid way of letting me off the hook.

facts.fact: 两个月纯吸引、一个吻都没接过——她形容这在青少年里 unheard of。
facts.anchor: Two months of pure attraction, without kissing.

facts.fact: 生日受辱：Eloise 在她生日当天开派对，当面骂她 lazy bitch（只因杯垫没归位）。
facts.anchor: Then she proceeded to call me a lazy bitch in front of her friends.

facts.fact: 谈去留：她说父亲已做出选择，现在轮到她做自己的。
facts.anchor: “He’s made his choice. Now, I get to make mine.”

facts.fact: 悬崖跳水：两人喊着口令一起跃入冰水。
水中相拥：Sean 呼吸急促、箍紧她的腰，第一次叫她 Bee。
facts.anchor: taking quick gasps as his grip becomes tighter around my waist.

facts.fact: 瀑布作背景的画面她想「拍进脑子」永远不忘。
facts.anchor: I take a little snapshot in my brain so I’ll never forget it.
